items.name: volcano-small-differences
items.prompt: Make one WIDE contact sheet with THREE equal square PAINTING DRAFTS side by side labeled A B C, all using EXACTLY THE SAME selected composition. Reference1 is previous storyboard sheet; use ONLY its RIGHTMOST C panel for composition, not its paint finish. Reference2 (flower held girl) and reference3 (chained witch) are APPROVED DRAWING STYLE references only: borrow opaque grouped color masses, economical broad directional paint, confident handmade edges and selective detail, not their poses/props. Character is the silver-haired bespectacled pointed-ear witch in reference1. FIXED composition in every panel: elevated diagonal view, witch's head/hat and upper body occupy upper left, one black-gloved hand reaches diagonally toward a huge vortex-like volcanic fissure occupying lower right, a few dark paper-shaped fragments follow that diagonal into its hot small center; a broad orange energy arc links upper right edge to lower-right funnel. Keep subject positions, camera, gesture, funnel size and motion direction identical in all three panels. No held round fireball. Quiet abstract dark violet/charcoal background, warm ivory/orange fissure accents. PAINTING VARIANTS: A has maximum grouped masses, only 3 broad hair locks and 3 coat planes, very few bold orange wedges defining the vortex; face/hand readable but everything else terse. B has the same large grouped shapes plus a few clearly directional wide paint swipes describing coat, hair and curved eruption, slightly more selective facial definition like approved references. C has the same grouped shapes with deeper connected charcoal shadows, fewer brighter ivory/orange light shapes, decisive handmade hard edges and a few broad angular dabs. All three must be visibly ROUGH HAND-PAINTED ANIME, not polished illustration, smooth gradients, soft chiffon folds, detailed strands, fragmented triangular facets, thin sparks or noisy texture coatings. Matte muted colored grays; concentrated chromatic accent. Paint strokes CONSTRUCT forms, not a filter on top of fine rendering. No writing besides A B C, no frame/UI/watermark.

items.name: wind-small-differences
items.prompt: Make a WIDE contact sheet of THREE equal square PAINTING DRAFTS labeled A B C side by side, all with EXACTLY THE SAME selected composition. Reference1 is previous storyboard sheet: use ONLY RIGHTMOST C panel as composition authority, not its smooth paint finish. Reference2 (flower held girl) and reference3 (chained witch) are APPROVED PAINTING STYLE only; borrow grouped opaque masses, broad directional strokes, handmade hard shadow edges and selective detail; do not copy their identities/props. Subject is Xingyue in reference1: pale gold long hair grouped into large locks with low braid, small crescent clip, white priestess dress, deep teal cape, restrained gold accents. FIXED composition in all panels: centered frontal figure in lower two-thirds, head tilted slightly upward and eyes closed singing, one hand at heart, another open relaxed lower left; enormous cropped pale crescent in the top band releases broad vertical rain marks, a handful of large ivory paper-shaped spell leaves float either side; cape forms a connected dark triangular base. Preserve camera, pose, scale and positions exactly in each panel. Dark muted teal background; ivory light, muted gold hair, clear separation of face/hands, cape and background. VARIANTS: A maximum simplification, hair in 3 large locks, dress 3 principal fold planes, rain only a few broad pale strokes, spell leaves plain big silhouettes. B same grouped masses with a few broad directional swipes following cloth and hair, readable face/hands selectively resolved, confident unfinished edges like the approved references. C same composition with deeper connected dark teal shadows around cape and background, larger quiet ivory dress masses, strong hard handmade light-shadow boundaries, sparse blunt dabs. Every panel rough hand-painted ANIME COLOR STUDY, matte opaque paint; no refined flowing hair strands, smooth chiffon, soft airbrush gradients, fine gold trim filigree, dense narrow rainfall, even outlined cel/vector fill, fragmented facet mosaics, noisy texture filters or glossy fantasy poster rendering. Wide brushwork should build shapes instead of decorating a detailed drawing. No text except A B C; no UI/frame/watermark.

items.name: style-A
items.prompt: Create TWO square game-card draft paintings side by side on one wide sheet, left labeled A1 and right A2. Reference1: use ONLY its RIGHTMOST C panel for LEFT composition and witch identity. Reference2: use ONLY its RIGHTMOST C panel for RIGHT composition and priestess identity. References provide layout only; COMPLETELY replace their painting language. Left fixed layout: silver-haired glasses witch in upper left, black-gloved hand diagonal, a few black spell-card silhouettes falling into fiery orange funnel at lower right, broad diagonal energy sweep; muted purple black plus orange. Right fixed layout: frontal pale-gold-haired priestess low center, crescent overhead, one hand at heart and one lower open palm, white rain and spell-leaf silhouettes falling, deep teal cape forms triangular base, muted teal ivory gold. SAME compositions as selected C. STYLE A: radically simplified HAND-CUT GOUACHE POSTER study. Almost NO outlines and NO visible small brush strokes. Build EACH entire figure from fewer than twelve large connected opaque shapes. Hair as two or three solid curved masses, face one pale plane with tiny anime facial marks, garment as huge clean light/shadow zones, edges slightly handmade irregular rather than vector-perfect. Only TWO value levels for each material. Flames as THREE large interlocking orange/ivory shapes, rain as FIVE broad ivory bars. Massive quiet flat-color areas. No internal hatching, grain, photorealism, smooth shading, fine details or mosaic facets. This must be visibly much flatter and simpler than the reference images. Two draft panels only, no UI/watermark.

items.name: style-B
items.prompt: Create TWO square game-card draft paintings side by side on one wide sheet, left labeled B1 and right B2. Reference1 ONLY RIGHTMOST C panel provides LEFT layout/witch identity. Reference2 ONLY RIGHTMOST C panel provides RIGHT layout/priestess identity. Completely IGNORE references' paint finish. Left: silver-haired glasses pointed-ear witch upper left, black gloved hand reaching diagonally, several black paper cards descend into orange volcanic funnel lower right, large curved orange energy arc. Right: pale-gold-haired priestess centered lower two-thirds, eyes shut singing, one hand at heart and other low open palm, dark teal cape triangle, immense pale cropped crescent above, broad rain falling through spell paper leaves. Preserve these C layouts and silhouettes. STYLE B is expressive OPAQUE OIL-STICK / LOADED FLAT-BRUSH ANIME PAINTING, visibly unlike smooth or faceted reference art: huge rounded dragging sweeps, broad curved chunky strokes, overlapping wet opaque patches with irregular blunt edges, visible paint coverage and underpainting gaps. Shapes built by LONG CONTINUOUS WIDE STROKES, not little triangular polygon patches. Hair in 3 sweeping locks; flowing cape and cloth described by 4-5 heavy brush curves; nose/mouth tiny clear anime marks, hands economical readable. No ink outlining. Flame funnel sculpted with several broad curved orange and ivory impasto-like strokes; rain several thick soft-ended ivory swipes. Quiet muted violet/charcoal left and teal/ivory/gold right; low detail, lively handcrafted marks, matte paint. No grain filter, tiny scratches, fine strands, thin sparks, faceted mosaic, photoreal material or glossy fantasy finish. Two rough painting drafts, not final art, no UI/watermark.

items.name: style-C
items.prompt: Create TWO square game-card draft paintings side by side on one wide sheet, left labeled C1 and right C2. Reference1 only RIGHTMOST C panel provides left composition/witch identity; reference2 only RIGHTMOST C panel provides right composition/priestess identity. Do not copy references' rendering. Left composition: silver long-haired witch with glasses, hat and pointed ears at upper left; hand diagonally reaches toward huge orange fire funnel lower right while black paper-card shapes drop into it; diagonal fire arc. Right composition: pale-gold long-haired priestess frontal low center singing eyes shut, one hand at heart other open low left, enormous cropped pale crescent top, rain and paper leaves descend, deep teal cape forms broad triangular base. Keep these selected C camera angles and positions. STYLE C: BOLD CALLIGRAPHIC BRUSH-INK AND OPAQUE GOUACHE ANIME sketch. This direction MUST have unmistakable thick expressive dark ink strokes defining hands, facial features, hair-group boundaries, cape structure and energy direction, with varied-width, broken, tapering gestural marks. Large opaque muted color blocks fill between the ink gestures, some intentional unfilled negative-space cuts. Face distinctly anime, hair grouped, few sharp structural lines, no small decorative contour tracing. Connected black shadows make a strong graphic silhouette. Fire has a few bold orange gouache wedges crossed by broad curved black gestural strokes; rain uses spaced vertical blunt pale strokes. Violet charcoal orange left, muted teal cream gold right. Clearly visible LINE-AND-COLOR construction unlike outline-free painterly images. No fine hatching, random scratch texture, smooth airbrushing, photoreal detail, continuous even vector outlines or mosaic facets. Economical rough drafts. No text except C1 C2, no UI/watermark.
